summary: Completed the client-visible result mapping in the read-surface interpretation by reading getRequestState branch by branch. A completed result returns normally; a timeout result and an expired caller deadline return ErrTimeout, a caller cancellation returns ErrCanceled, a dropped result returns ErrClusterNotReady, and rejected, terminated and aborted results return ErrRejected, ErrClusterClosed and ErrAborted. That adds the cancellation endpoint a caller observes when it aborts its own read, distinct from the timeout the stranded-batch case produces, and the limitation now states the mapping was read branch by branch including the cancellation branch. Sources, question and conclusion are unchanged. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with an interpretation append changing rationale and limitations. No execution was run.
